product: Carbon Black Cloud Data Forwarder alerts
author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This parser reads Carbon Black Cloud alerts from a Data Forwarder of type alert, gzipped JSON with one alert per line. The forwarder writes to an Amazon S3 bucket that a Sophos NG-SIEM S3 Ingest (customer-managed) integration reads. Every alert type goes to the third-party alert schema.
notes:
Setup:
- Set up a Data Forwarder of type alert in Carbon Black Cloud to an Amazon S3 bucket (in the same AWS region as your Carbon Black Cloud org), and read the bucket with a Sophos NG-SIEM S3 Ingest (customer-managed) integration.
- The forwarder writes gzipped JSON, one alert per line.

Field mapping:
- Every alert type goes to the third-party alert schema, with the type as the category, the report name or reason as the title, severity from the 1 to 10 scale (1 to 3 low, 4 to 6 medium, 7 and 8 high, 9 and 10 critical), and blocked when the sensor action is DENY or TERMINATE.
- Network alerts give the device's side and the other side; they map to source and destination by Inbound or Outbound in the reason, outbound when it doesn't say.
- Schema 2.0.0 and 2.1.0 both parse.
- Endpoint event, audit log and watchlist hit forwarders stay generic.

Time:
- Each backend update and each workflow change forwards another copy of the alert with the same id, so the event time is backend_update_timestamp; use alert_id and updated_time_usec to tell copies apart.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are made up in the shapes of Carbon Black's schema examples.

Testing:
- Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-14 (162 of 162 fields matched the emulator, in each of 3 runs).
- No built-in parser claimed these lines, or Carbon Black's own schema examples, in 5 Run Tests.
